title: Correlated sector pairs
statementMd:
For each trading day compare the technology tickers: list days where BYTE and CLOUD both closed up (close above open). Show the count of such days as `both_up_days`.

Expected columns: `both_up_days`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS both_up_days FROM prices a JOIN prices b ON a.trade_date = b.trade_date AND a.symbol = 'BYTE' AND b.symbol = 'CLOUD' WHERE a.close > a.open AND b.close > b.open;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
